projects.title: Pump room shop drawings for the artificial lakes at The Estates, SODIC
projects.meta: ARBEC · SODIC The Estates, Sheikh Zayed · 2026
projects.summary: Pump room shop drawings and site supervision for the two artificial lakes at SODIC's The Estates. Drawings approved by the consultant (Code B).
projects.lead: Site technical office work at ARBEC on the two artificial lakes of SODIC's The Estates compound in Sheikh Zayed. I prepared the mechanical shop drawings for the lake pump rooms, got them approved by the consultant, and supervised the installation of the mechanical works on site.

facts.label: Scope
facts.value: 2 artificial lakes with their pump rooms

sections.title: What I did
points: Prepared the pump room shop drawings for Lake 06: a general layout and two room sections.
Showed the pump room position, coordinates and connections to the lake on the general layout.
Detailed the equipment and pipe levels inside the pump room in sections 1-1 and 2-2.
Submitted the drawings to the consultant and got them approved with comments (Code B).
Supervised the installation of the mechanical works in the lake pump rooms on site.

projects.title: Sewage lift stations at The Estates, SODIC
projects.meta: ARBEC · SODIC The Estates, Sheikh Zayed · 2026
projects.summary: MEP shop drawings for the four sewage lift stations at SODIC's The Estates: submersible pumps, HDPE pipework, valve chambers and manhole connections. Approved by the consultant (Code B).
projects.lead: Site technical office work at ARBEC on the four sewage lift stations of SODIC's The Estates compound in Sheikh Zayed. I prepared the MEP shop drawings for the pump stations, covering the wet well, the valve chamber and the connections to the sewer manholes, and got them approved by the consultant.
projects.coverCaption: Illustration: section through a sewage lift station

facts.label: Pumps (PS-01)
facts.value: 3 submersible (2 duty + 1 standby) · Q = 16 L/s · H = 20 m

facts.label: Pipework
facts.value: HDPE PN10 / PN16 · Ø200 uPVC inlet

sections.title: What I did
points: Prepared the MEP shop drawing for pump stations ((PS-01)(PS-02)(PS-03)(PS-04): pumps, guide rails, basket screen, valve chambers and the bill of pipes and fittings.
Prepared the overall drawing of Lift Stations #1,2,3,4 with the chamber details, manhole levels, pipe slopes and coordinates.
Submitted the drawings to the consultant and got them approved with comments (Code B).

sections.title: Inside each pump station
points: Submersible sewage pumps on guide rails with lifting chains, and a galvanized steel basket screen on the inlet.
Gate valves, non-return valves and dismantling joints on each discharge line.
Surge anticipating valve and a non-slam air valve on the rising main.
Ø200 uPVC line to the odor control system, and a stainless steel 316 ladder.
